Artiﬁcial intelligence for automated code generation in manufacturing systems
Table, Processed, Annotated
The dataset was created by manually drafting baseline requirement speciﬁcations
for manufacturing systems. These speciﬁcations were expanded into multiple
variations using large language models (ChatGPT Pro, Claude Pro, and Mistral Pro).
After expert validation, each speciﬁcation was formally annotated using a custom
labeling tool with BIO tags (Begin, Inside, Outside) for Named Entity Recognition
(NER).
